Then we apply a max-reducing local search (2-opt, relocate, swap) that only accepts moves that strictly reduce the current maximum route distance. After that, an intra-route 2-opt that reduces total distance without increasing max. The shake phase removes 10-15% of customers, with 50% probability from the longest route and 50% from a random route with at least 3 customers, then reinserts using regret-2 minimizing max distance. All loops are bounded by O(n * truck_count) and we call report_best_vrp upon improvements. Tie-breaking: choose the insertion that minimizes max distance; if tie, prefer lower route length.
